title: Pinned gluing across a finite modification
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $X$ be Noetherian excellent with $\ell$ invertible and dimension function $\delta$ [def-exc-excellent-ring, def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Let $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion with complementary open $U$, and $p:X'\to X$ a finite morphism inducing an isomorphism $p^{-1}U\to U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Form $Y'=Y\times_XX'$ with maps $i':Y'\to X'$, $p':Y'\to Y$, and $q=pi'=ip'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Give $X',Y,Y'$ their induced dimension functions $\delta_W(w)=\delta(f(w))$. Suppose each of these three schemes admits a pinned potential dualizing complex, any two on each scheme have a unique pinning-preserving isomorphism, and for every such complex $L$ on each scheme $W$ the scalar map $\Lambda_W\to\tau_{\leq0}R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(L,L)$ is an isomorphism [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then these three assertions hold on $X$ as well. More precisely, writing $K_{X'},K_Y,K_{Y'}$ for the chosen pinned complexes, the adjunction maps from $K_{Y'}\cong p'^!K_Y\cong i'^!K_{X'}$ give a distinguished triangle
$$q_*K_{Y'}\xrightarrow{(+,-)}i_*K_Y\oplus p_*K_{X'}\longrightarrow K_X\longrightarrow q_*K_{Y'}[1]$$
in $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Its cone admits pinnings for which $K_Y\to i^!K_X$ and $K_{X'}\to p^!K_X$ are pinning-preserving isomorphisms. Here for a finite map $f$, $f^!$ is the bounded-below right adjoint to $f_*=Rf_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support].

source.place: Expose XVII, Proposition 5.4.1 and its proof, pp. 290-293 (existence, pinned comparison, and scalar Hom rigidity; no perversity clause is asserted here)
